items.condition: earnings_revision is present and guidance_cut is absent
items.exception: if guidance_cut is present, do not increase_long

[exp_k_revision] status=experimental_only
WHEN earnings_revision is present and guidance_cut is absent
THEN increase_long
EXCEPT if guidance_cut is present, do not increase_long
SOURCES fix_a1

items.condition: Street earnings estimates are revised upward following a new operating update.
items.judgment: Increase long exposure on the revision, treating upward estimate revisions as a constructive catalyst.
items.exception: If a concurrent negative signal such as a guidance cut is also present, the guidance signal takes precedence and the long thesis is not initiated.

items.condition: A positive earnings revision coincides with crowded short interest.
items.judgment: The crowded short positioning amplifies the constructive impact of the upward revision, reinforcing the decision to increase long exposure.
items.exception: The amplification only applies when the underlying revision is positive; crowding does not rescue a negative fundamental signal.

items.condition: Management cuts forward guidance and narrows the delivery range.
items.judgment: Avoid initiating a trade; the guidance cut is treated as a dominant negative fundamental that overrides other signals.
items.exception: Even when short interest is crowded, the guidance cut still forces avoidance because crowding cannot offset a deteriorated fundamental outlook.

[exp_earnings_revision_up_long] status=experimental_only
WHEN Street earnings estimates are revised upward following a new operating update.
THEN Increase long exposure on the revision, treating upward estimate revisions as a constructive catalyst.

[exp_short_crowding_amplifies_revision] status=experimental_only
WHEN A positive earnings revision coincides with crowded short interest.
THEN The crowded short positioning amplifies the constructive impact of the upward revision, reinforcing the decision to increase long exposure.
EXCEPT The amplification only applies when the underlying revision is positive; crowding does not rescue a negative fundamental signal.
SOURCES fix_t2

[exp_guidance_cut_avoids_trade] status=experimental_only
WHEN Management cuts forward guidance and narrows the delivery range.
THEN Avoid initiating a trade; the guidance cut is treated as a dominant negative fundamental that overrides other signals.
EXCEPT Even when short interest is crowded, the guidance cut still forces avoidance because crowding cannot offset a deteriorated fundamental outlook.
SOURCES fix_t3,fix_t4
